description: Per-struct lr_cpu execution state and stacks finite independent example
verification_method: research/v3/verify_fixtures.py independently recomputes this declared finite example; implementation and hardware evidence remain separate
mechanism_contract: Each struct lr_cpu owns its current-task pointer, interrupt nesting state, idle stack and fault context. Sharing a stack corrupts independent execution even when global counters are atomic. Per-struct lr_cpu storage reduces contention only when ownership and cache-line placement are explicit.
required_observation: Demonstrate nonoverlapping live stack ranges and struct lr_cpu-local identities under parallel work. A fault record must identify its struct lr_cpu and retain peer progress evidence.
